tweetText: GitHub Copilot is introducing token-based billing, causing frustration among developers. This change signals a shift in how AI tools are accessed, raising concerns about costs and accessibility. via TechCrunch AI

Meta is reportedly working on an AI-powered pendant. This move highlights their commitment to integrating AI into everyday devices, potentially changing how we interact with technology. via TechCrunch AI

Google's 24/7 AI assistant, Gemini Spark, is proving useful for automating tasks like inbox summaries and event planning. Its separate identity raises questions about Google's strategy in the AI space. via TechCrunch AI

I tested Wispr Flow and other AI transcription tools to see if paid services are worth it compared to free options. This matters because choosing the right tool can save you time and money. via WIRED AI

Craig Campbell chose to focus on building a website instead of jumping into the AI frenzy, despite pressure from investors. His decision highlights a growing interest in traditional web projects amidst the AI hype. via The Verge AI.

AI-generated influencers are deceiving users on TikTok by posing as Black women to sell cheap products. This highlights the growing issue of authenticity in social media marketing and exploitation of racial identities. via The Verge AI
